note: Four forested campground loops on a chain of small stocked lakes, about 32 km east of Grande Cache off Hwy 40: Wanyandie (by McDonald Lake), Moberly, Delorme and Joachim (unserviced) on Moberly and Desjarlais lakes. Boat launches, a pier and fish-cleaning stations; no cell service. The nearest dump and potable water are the free seasonal station in Grande Cache or Gregg Lake Campground's (fee). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Oct 28, 2026), shop and tear sheet: unserviced C$30, power (30 A) +C$8, mix of reservable and FCFS; power sites corrected 65 -> 61 (page), count 87 -> 83 (shop holds 81); max rig 61 ft, 12 pull-throughs (loop W); vault toilets, non-potable pump, no dump. Season May 13 - Sep 15 already manual and matches. Lakeview kept marginally (canopy). Pin is at McDonald Day Use, ~1.3 km from three of the four loops.
flags: PHONE: stored 780-827-2651 matches the page's 'Information: 780-827-2651' (the tear sheet gives the Grande Cache Parks Office 780-827-7393). No Facility Operator line. Websites: both stored URLs answered 200.
SITE COUNT: page 22 + 61 = 83; shop lists 81 (22 + 23 + 19 + 17). Written 83 (the page). Sites under 23 ft: D-14, D-19, D-24, J-15, J-19, J-21, J-22, M-07 - most fit.

STATUS: advisory 'Closed for the season' effective Sep 15, 2026 ('We look forward to seeing you May long weekend!') - seasonal, no status. Shop 'Closed through Tue May 18 2027' (the page's 2026 season began May 13). No seniors line on this page.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - keep, marginal; reviewer may downgrade): every loop sits under continuous conifer canopy. Shop 'Near Water' tags: J-01, J-03, J-05, J-07, J-11, J-12 (Joachim), D-16 (Delorme), M-06 (Moberly); none in Wanyandie. On imagery Joachim's north spurs are ~20-37 m from the Moberly lake's south lobe and Moberly loop's east branch ~30-50 m from Moberly Lake, both through a tree fringe (no on-water: tree belt); Wanyandie is ~80 m from McDonald Lake through forest; Delorme's spurs ~50-90 m through trees. The page says 'a series of small lakes, each with lakeside camping'. A view through the fringe can't be confirmed or vetoed under canopy; the per-site Near Water flags are the only per-site evidence. Recommend lakeview kept with a caveat that it is the eight Near Water sites; if the reviewer reads the tree fringe as blocking the view, not waterfront.

PIN (53.90720,-118.60660): at McDonald Day Use (the tear sheet's parking/registration icons on McDonald Lake), ~300 m west of the Wanyandie loop and ~1.3 km from Moberly, Delorme and Joachim. The page's directions point 53.904921,-118.586783 falls in the Delorme loop, central to D, M and J. Recommend moving to 53.90492,-118.58678 (~1.3 km east).
